## Readings

<!-- Answer every axis in one of four forms, the clause naming what the axis's question would have to touch: `answered: <exemplar or site>` (one subsection each), `trivial: <what it reduces to>`, `not applicable: <what the change lacks that the axis asks about>`, or `deferred: #n`. Never `not selected`, a blank or a bare form. An axis the issue marks `yes` answered other than `answered:` takes a `- `<axis>` — departed: …` item in `## Sources read`. -->

| Family | Axis | Question | Status |
| ------ | ---- | -------- | ------ |
| Identity | `univalent` | what univalence and the rewriting core give the construction: an equation, a transported rule, a replayed cell, representation independence | |
| Locality | `oracle` | which part is decided by certificate replay and which is computed; which modality or dominance classifies it | |
| Locality | `descent` | the local data, the interface, the assembly; what a change invalidates and reuses; the parallel width left | |
| Place | `located` | at which world a judgement or value is meaningful; what crosses worlds, and by what | |
| Place | `resident` | representation, sharing, persistence; where integrity stops and replay decides | |
| Dimension | `rewriting` | rules and normal forms; rewrites between rewrites; which coherence tier settles them | |
| Cost | `zero-cost` | what the change adds at run time and what demands it: a grade above zero, a located crossing or a session branch (the program), or a recipe policy off by default (none of its bytes in an artifact built without it); what the grade erases; what a hand-written form would cost | |
